_comment: Daily history (METRICS 8, 9.7) over all fixtures, grouped in UTC, after setting each file's modification time from parser-expected.json `mtimes`. Costs use the fixture price tables in `prices.tables` (paths relative to spec/fixtures; the highest version is the current table) with the stored day bindings `prices.bindings`; unbound days bind to the current table. `unpriced` lists the day's unpriced facts (METRICS 9.10): trimmed raw model, provider (null when none), fast, requests, as stored in the side table `contribution_unpriced` summed over files, ordered by the UTF-8 bytes of model, then provider (null first), then fast; its requests add up to `unpricedRequests`. `perf` lists the performance history records (METRICS 6.11) per day, source and model (UTF-8 bytes; the empty string for none), from every agent's completions in the order they complete (toolLnSum within 1e-9). Generated by spec/tools/reference.py --write-history-fixture; platforms must match exactly.
